transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: And Amira and I are here today with a great, great lesson for you.
transcript.zh: 今天阿米拉和我为大家带来一堂非常非常棒的课程。

transcript.en: Today we're going to be talking about a restaurant.
transcript.zh: 今天我们要聊一聊餐厅。

transcript.en: Amira, why don't you give us a little bit more details?
transcript.zh: 阿米拉，你来给大家多介绍一点细节？

transcript.en: Well, we are talking about a situation in a restaurant and two people are involved, the waiter and the customer.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们要讲的是一个餐厅里的场景，涉及两个人，服务员和顾客。

transcript.en: And I don't want to say any more.
Let's just listen to this dialogue and we'll be back later to explain it.
transcript.zh: 我们先来听这段对话，稍后回来讲解。

transcript.en: I'll be your waiter for tonight.
No, I'm still working on it.
This menu is not even in English.
For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
transcript.zh: 先生，我向您推荐意大利面和肉丸。

transcript.en: Does it come with coke and fries?
It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
transcript.zh: 配汤或沙拉任选其一，另赠送一杯葡萄酒，先生。

transcript.en: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
transcript.zh: 我要意大利面和肉丸，配沙拉和葡萄酒。

transcript.en: Your order will be ready soon.
transcript.zh: 您的餐点很快就准备好。

transcript.en: I'll go grab a burger across the street.
transcript.zh: 我去街对面买个汉堡算了。

transcript.en: He is really angry at this customer and I can't blame him.
transcript.zh: 他对这位顾客真的很生气，这也难怪他。

transcript.en: So, I think, Marco, you have chosen some interesting expressions for us here.
transcript.zh: 那么，马可，我想你给我们选了一些有趣的表达方式。

transcript.en: Well, the first one is I'm still working on it.
transcript.zh: 嗯，第一个是 I'm still working on it。

transcript.en: Why don't we listen to some other examples on how you can use this word and then we'll come back and explain it.
transcript.zh: 我们来听几个关于这个词用法的其他例子，然后再回来解释。

transcript.en: Did you finish reading the magazine?
Ah, so you could say I'm still working on it means I still need more time.
transcript.zh: 啊，所以你可以说 I'm still working on it 意思是我还需要更多时间。

transcript.en: I have another one for you guys.
transcript.zh: 我还有一个要分享给大家。

transcript.en: It's a phrase commonly used and you'll hear it all the time.
transcript.zh: 这是一个很常用的短语，你会经常听到。

transcript.en: It's a short way of saying Coca-Cola and French fries.
transcript.zh: 这是可口可乐和法式薯条的简称。

transcript.en: So that's basically America's fast food.
transcript.zh: 所以基本上就是美国快餐。

transcript.en: On the menu we have a complimentary glass of wine.
transcript.zh: 菜单上还有一杯赠送的葡萄酒。

transcript.en: Yeah, we definitely like free things.
transcript.zh: 是啊，我们当然喜欢免费的东西。

transcript.en: Well, I have another one for us here, another interesting phrase.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我这还有一个有趣的短语。

transcript.en: So basically it's another way of saying I'm choosing.
transcript.zh: 所以基本上这是「我选择」的另一种说法。

transcript.en: Yeah, I'll choose or I'll take.
transcript.zh: 对，我选择或我就要这个。

transcript.en: Alright, the next word that I want to take a look at is grab.
transcript.zh: 好的，下一个我想讲的词是 grab。

transcript.en: OK, now let's listen to some other examples of how we could use grab in different situations and then we'll come back and explain it.
transcript.zh: 好，现在来听几个其他例子，看看 grab 在不同场景中如何使用，然后我们回来解释。

transcript.en: On your way home, can you grab some milk?
transcript.zh: 回家路上能帮我带瓶牛奶吗？
请等我一下，我需要去拿一下外套。

transcript.en: I need to grab my coat.
Let's grab a cup of coffee.
transcript.zh: 好了，那么我理解为 go grab 意思是快去拿/快去买。

transcript.en: All right, well, I would understand that go grab means go get quickly.
So now it's time to listen one more time to the dialogue and listen carefully and try to understand why the waiter doesn't like the customer.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来再听一遍对话，仔细听，试着理解为什么服务员不喜欢这位顾客。

transcript.en: I'll be your waiter for tonight.
No, I'm still working on it.
This menu is not even in English.
For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
transcript.zh: 先生，我向您推荐意大利面和肉丸。

transcript.en: Does it come with Coke and fries?
It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
transcript.zh: 配汤或沙拉任选其一，另赠送一杯葡萄酒，先生。

transcript.en: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
transcript.zh: 我要意大利面和肉丸，配沙拉和葡萄酒。

transcript.en: Your order will be ready soon.
transcript.zh: 您的餐点很快就准备好。

transcript.en: I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
transcript.zh: 我还是去街对面买个汉堡算了。

transcript.en: Marco, why did this waiter get angry at the customer?
transcript.zh: 马可，为什么这位服务员对顾客生气了？

transcript.en: Well, he basically wasted the waiter's time.
transcript.zh: 嗯，他基本上浪费了服务员的时间。

transcript.en: I mean, this guy comes into the restaurant.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，这家伙走进餐厅，

transcript.en: He is not very polite and he's asking all these questions.
transcript.zh: 他不太礼貌，还问了这么多问题。

transcript.en: In the end, he just gets up and says, I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
transcript.zh: 最后，他直接站起来说，我还是去街对面买个汉堡算了。

transcript.en: Yeah, and I also think that this guy was a lot more casual than the place he was in,
transcript.zh: 是啊，而且我也觉得这家伙比他所处的场合要随意得多，对吧？

transcript.en: I think this was a nice, fancy restaurant.
transcript.zh: 我觉得这是一家不错的高级餐厅。

transcript.en: So I think he was in the wrong place.
transcript.zh: 所以我觉得他走错地方了。

transcript.en: So how many times, Marco, tell me, do you really have fast food a week?
transcript.zh: 那么马可，告诉我，你一周到底吃几次快餐？

transcript.en: Fast food, let's see, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
transcript.zh: 快餐啊，让我想想，周一、周二、周三。

transcript.en: I think I get fast food maybe once a week, once or twice a week.
transcript.zh: 我想我大概一周吃一次快餐，一周一两次吧。

transcript.en: All right, talking about fast food made me hungry.
transcript.zh: 好了，聊快餐把我都聊饿了。

transcript.en: So I think I'm going to go grab something to eat myself.
transcript.zh: 所以我想我也去给自己弄点吃的。

transcript.en: I hope you guys enjoyed the lesson today and remember that all of this vocabulary is useful for your everyday needs.
transcript.zh: 希望大家喜欢今天的课程，记住所有这些词汇对你的日常生活都很有用。

transcript.en: Well, actually here in EnglishPod, we focus on phrases and words that are high frequency and that means that you can use them every day in your practical life.
transcript.zh: 嗯，其实在 EnglishPod，我们专注于高频短语和词汇，这意味着你可以在日常生活中每天都用到它们。

transcript.en: And be sure to go to our website at EnglishPod.com where you can find many other resources and you can leave your questions and comments at our community forum.
transcript.zh: 请务必访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，在那里你可以找到更多资源，还可以在我们的社区论坛留下你的问题和评论。

transcript.en: So thank you very much for listening.
We'll be back tomorrow with another great lesson for you.
transcript.zh: 明天我们会带来另一堂精彩的课程。
